	<file line="139-L144">lua/includes/util.lua</file>
	<args>

		<arg name="max" type="number" default="90 for pitch, 180 for yaw and roll">Max bound exclusive.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Angle">The randomly generated angle.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
